text: Stores documents and embeddings and serves full-text, semantic, and conversational search from a single API
quote: It stores your documents and embeddings, then exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API.

text: Cloud quickstart walks through creating a project and index, adding documents, and running a first search in the web interface
quote: This tutorial walks you through setting up Meilisearch Cloud, creating a project and an index, adding documents to it, and performing your first search with the default web interface.

text: Typo tolerance returns relevant results even when queries contain misspellings
quote: Typo tolerance helps users find relevant results even when their search queries contain spelling mistakes or typos, for example, typing `phnoe` instead of `phone`.

text: Typo tolerance is configurable per index, including minimum word sizes for allowing typos
quote: You can override these default settings using the minWordSizeForTypos object.

text: Seven built-in ranking rules whose order can be changed to fit your needs

text: Supports custom ranking rules in addition to the built-in ones
quote: There are two types of ranking rules in Meilisearch: built-in ranking rules and custom ranking rules.

text: Define lists of synonyms so equivalent words match each other
quote: If multiple words have an equivalent meaning in your dataset, you can create a list of synonyms. This will make your search results more relevant.

text: Dynamic search rules boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request

text: Faceted navigation lets users narrow results by attributes like brand, color, size, and price, with counts shown for each option
quote: E-commerce faceted navigation: Let shoppers narrow products by brand, color, size, and price range while displaying counts for each option.

text: A dedicated facet search endpoint supports type-ahead and autocomplete over the values of a facet
quote: Use the facet search endpoint to type-ahead through facet values, build auto-complete experiences, and narrow large filter lists.

text: Filtering, sorting, and range refinements narrow search results

text: Geosearch for location-based results
quote: Leverage reliable and performant search with features like geosearch and faceting for improved relevancy.

text: A configured embedder automatically generates vector embeddings for every document, so you don't compute or manage them yourself
quote: When you configure an embedder, Meilisearch automatically generates vector embeddings for every document in your index. You don't need to compute or manage embeddings yourself.

text: Hybrid search combines keyword full-text matching with semantic meaning-based search
quote: Hybrid search combines two search strategies: full-text search (matching keywords) and semantic search (matching meaning).

text: Multimodal search lets users find images, video, and audio by meaning
quote: Search beyond text. Let users find images, video, and audio the same way they search words, by meaning, not just file names or tags.

text: Conversational search answers user questions grounded in your own content
quote: Let users ask questions and get real answers, grounded in your own content. No hallucinations, no guessing.

text: Acts as a retrieval layer that gives AI models accurate, current context from your data
quote: The retrieval layer your AI applications need. Give your models accurate, current context from your own data.

text: Federated search queries every index in parallel and merges results into one ranked list
quote: One query searches every index in parallel. Results are merged and ranked into a single list, no client-side logic required.

text: Personalization adapts results to each user's preferences and behavior
quote: Tailor every search to every user. Surface what is most relevant to each person based on their preferences and behavior.

text: Analytics track search queries, clicks, and conversions to measure search quality
quote: Track search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality and identify opportunities for improvement.

text: Tenant tokens are short-lived scoped credentials whose embedded filters restrict each user to their own data
quote: Tenant tokens are short-lived, scoped credentials generated from an API key. They embed search rules (filters) that automatically apply to every search request, ensuring users only see their own data.

text: Multi-tenancy works within a shared index, without separate indexes or infrastructure per customer
quote: Meilisearch handles multi-tenancy at the search level. Each tenant gets isolated access through secure tokens. No need for separate indexes or infrastructure per customer.

text: API keys authenticate requests and control access to data
quote: API keys authenticate requests, while tenant tokens restrict what data each user can see within a shared index.

text: Ships as a single binary with no external dependencies and runs on Linux, macOS, or Windows, on bare metal or in containers
quote: Meilisearch is a single binary with no external dependencies. You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.
